## funtional forms of diffrent vector feilds
```{r}
# example from Vector Feild interpolation with RFB paper
VF_1 = function(v) c(v[1]*(1/2*v[1]^2+1/2)+v[2]*(-v[1]+(1/2*v[2]-1)*v[2]+1/2),1/2*v[1]^2*v[2]+v[1]*(-1/2*v[2]^2+v[2]-1/2)+1/2*v[2]-1) 

div_VF_1 = function(v) c(  bgt)

# example of Vector feild with limit cycle using the 
#Van der Pol oscillator
VF_LimitCycle=function(v) c(v[2],.1*(1-v[1]^2)*v[2]-v[1])


VF_StableCycle=function(v) c(v[2],-v[1])

VF_SaddelNode=function(v) c(v[1],-2*v[2])

VF_UnstableNode=function(v) c(v[1]/2,v[2]/2)
```

## Calculate divergence of vector feilds
```{r}
VF_1_x=function(v){v[1]*(1/2*v[1]^2+1/2)+v[2]*(-v[1]+(1/2*v[2]-1)*v[2]+1/2)}
VF_1_y=function(v){1/2*v[1]^2*v[2]+v[1]*(-1/2*v[2]^2+v[2]-1/2)+1/2*v[2]-1}
VF_1 = function(v) c(VF_1_x(v),VF_1_y(v)) 
```


```{r}
VF_test=function(v)c(v[2],v[1]-v[1]^3-.02*v[2])

 p=ggplot() +

    )
 p
```



## numerical integrators
```{r}
forward_euler=function(x0, fun, step_size, n){

  path=list(x0)
  x=c(x0[1])
  y=c(x0[2])
  for(i in 2:n){
    path[[i]]=path[[i-1]]+step_size*fun(path[[i-1]])
    x[i]=path[[i]][1]
    y[i]=path[[i]][2]
  }
  path_df=data.frame(
    x=x,
    y=y
  )
  return(path_df)
}


backward_euler=function(x0, fun, step_size, n){

  path=list(x0)
  x=c(x0[1])
  y=c(x0[2])
  for(i in 2:n){
    path[[i]]=path[[i-1]]-step_size*fun(path[[i-1]])
    x[i]=path[[i]][1]
    y[i]=path[[i]][2]
  }
  path_df=data.frame(
    x=x,
    y=y
  )
  return(path_df)
}


```



#numerical integration with gaussian noise 
```{r}
euler_maryama=function(x0, fun, Q, step_size, n){
  
  path=list(x0)
  x=c(x0[1])
  y=c(x0[2])
  for(i in 2:n){
    temp =path[[i-1]]+step_size*fun(path[[i-1]])
    
    #we need to construct a joint normal distribution and and sample form that if     #the X and y components are not independent
    
    #if they are independent then this works
    suppressWarnings({
      temp_x=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[1,1]*step_size)
      temp_y=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[2,2]*step_size)
    })
    temp_x=temp_x+temp[1]
    temp_y=temp_y+temp[2]
    path[[i]] = c(temp_x,temp_y)
    x[i]=path[[i]][1]
    y[i]=path[[i]][2]
    }
  
  path_df=data.frame(
    x=x,
    y=y
  )
  return(path_df)
  }
```

```{r}
## create covariance matrix for process
sigma_1=.5
sigma_2=.5
Q=matrix(data = c(sigma_1,0,0,sigma_2), nrow = 2, ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE,
       dimnames = NULL)

#step_sizes=c(.01,.05,.1,.5)
step_sizes=c(.01)
plots=c()

for(step_size in step_sizes){
  
  paths=c()
  n_paths=20
  for(i in 1:n_paths){
     paths=c(paths,geom_path(data = euler_maryama(x0=c(-1.5,1.1), fun=VF_1,Q=Q,step_size=step_size, 100),aes(x = x, y = y),linewidth = .5,color = "lightblue"))
  }
  
  p=ggplot() +
    xlim(-5,5) +
    ylim(-5,5) +
    geom_vector_field(
      fun = VF_1,
      xlim=c(-5,5),
      ylim=c(-5,5),
      n=20,
      arrow = grid::arrow(angle = 15, length = unit(0.01, "npc"), type = "closed")
      
    )+
    paths+
    geom_path(data = forward_euler(c(-1.5,1.1), VF_1, step_size, 100),aes(x = x, y = y),linewidth = .8,color = "red")
  
  plots=c(p,plots)

}
```

```{r}


divergence=function(x,y){
  
  grad_x=pracma::grad(VF_1_x, x0 = c(x,y))
  grad_y=pracma::grad(VF_1_y, x0 = c(x,y))
  
  grad_x[1]+grad_y[2]

}

div_vec <- Vectorize(divergence)


x <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 100)
y <- seq(-5,5, length.out = 100)

z <- outer(x, y, div_vec)
# 4. Plot using image()
#image(x, y, z, col = hcl.colors(12, "YlOrRd", rev = TRUE))

# Alternatively, for a smoother look with a legend:
max_abs <- max(abs(z))

levels <- seq(-max_abs, max_abs, length.out = 100)

filled.contour(
  x,
  y,
  z,
  levels = levels,
  color.palette = colorRampPalette(
    c("blue", "white", "red")
  )
)
```

```{r}
VF_LimitCycle=function(v) c(v[2],.1*(1-v[1]^2)*v[2]-v[1])

  grad_x=pracma::grad(VF_LimitCycle_x, x0 = c(x,y))

```



```{r}
r=hycom_data2
coords_matrix <- xyFromCell(r, 1:ncell(r))

long=coords_matrix[,1]
lat=coords_matrix[,2]
velocity_u=values(hycom_data2$`water_u_depth=0`)
velocity_v=values(hycom_data2$`water_v_depth=0`)

hycom_df=data.frame(
  lat=lat,
  long=long,
  velocity_u=velocity_u,
  velocity_v=velocity_v
)
```


```{r}
#gets a subset of the data set to plot
n=20
hycom_df_filtered <- hycom_df[seq(1, nrow(hycom_df), n), ]

#scales the vector size with a sigmoid function
a=1
hycom_df_filtered$water_u_depth.0=a*(1/(1+exp(-hycom_df_filtered$water_u_depth.0)))-(a/2)
hycom_df_filtered$water_v_depth.0=a*(1/(1+exp(-hycom_df_filtered$water_v_depth.0)))-(a/2)
```


```{r}
ggplot(hycom_df_filtered) + 
  geom_quiver(
    aes(x=long, y=lat, u=water_u_depth.0, v=water_v_depth.0),
    vecsize = 0
  ) +coord_sf(xlim = c(min(hycom_df_filtered$long),max(hycom_df_filtered$long)), ylim = c(min(hycom_df_filtered$lat),max(hycom_df_filtered$lat)), expand = FALSE)
```

```{r}
forward_eule_Hycom=function(x0, flow_map, step_size, n){

  path=list(x0)
  x=c(x0[1])
  y=c(x0[2])
  u_raster=flow_map$`water_u_depth=0`
  v_raster=flow_map$`water_v_depth=0`
  for(i in 2:n){
    pt <- matrix(c(path[[i-1]][1], path[[i-1]][2]), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE)
    u = terra::extract(u_raster, pt, method="bilinear")$`water_u_depth=0`
    v = terra::extract(v_raster, pt, method="bilinear")$`water_v_depth=0`
    
    path[[i]]=path[[i-1]]+step_size*c(u,v)
    x[i]=path[[i]][1]
    y[i]=path[[i]][2]
  }
  path_df=data.frame(
    x=x,
    y=y
  )
  return(path_df)
}

stochastic_forward_euler_hycom=function(x0, flow_map, step_size, n, sd){
    path=list(x0)
    x=c(x0[1])
    y=c(x0[2])
    u_raster=flow_map$`water_u_depth=0`
    v_raster=flow_map$`water_v_depth=0`
    for(i in 2:n){
      
      pt <- matrix(c(path[[i-1]][1], path[[i-1]][2]), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE)
      u = terra::extract(u_raster, pt, method="bilinear")$`water_u_depth=0`
      v = terra::extract(v_raster, pt, method="bilinear")$`water_v_depth=0`
      
      temp =path[[i-1]]+step_size*c(u,v)
    
      temp_x=suppressWarnings(rnorm(n = 1, mean = temp[1], sd = sd))
      temp_y=suppressWarnings(rnorm(n = 1, mean = temp[2], sd = sd))
      path[[i]] = c(temp_x,temp_y)
      x[i]=path[[i]][1]
      y[i]=path[[i]][2]
    }
  
    path_df=data.frame(
      x=x,
      y=y
    )
    return(path_df)

}

```


```{r}
path1=forward_eule_Hycom(c(300.5,36.5),hycom_data2,.02,n=500)
path2=forward_eule_Hycom(c(300.5,39.5),hycom_data2,.1,n=500)
path3=forward_eule_Hycom(c(302.5,38),hycom_data2,.1,n=1000)
path4=stochastic_forward_euler_hycom(c(300.5,36.5),hycom_data2,.02,n=500, sd=.05)
```
